parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The N resources. The resources are domain names in this operation. Valid values of N: **1 to 50**.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resources. Set the value to **DOMAIN**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id example.com --tag Value=product Key=env --resource-type DOMAIN --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'example.com' --Tag.1.Key env --Tag.1.Value product --ResourceType DOMAIN --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
